description: Verifies the spectral shift and beaming relations: the longitudinal and transverse kinematic Doppler factors, the Schwarzschild gravitational redshift between a static emitter and a static observer, the g^3 and g^4 intensity and flux scalings, and the wavelength transformation.

checks.label: a head-on source is blueshifted by sqrt((1 + beta) / (1 - beta))
a receding source is redshifted by sqrt((1 - beta) / (1 + beta))
a transverse source shows pure time dilation 1 / gamma

checks.section: Gravitational redshift in the Schwarzschild metric
checks.label: the frequency ratio equals sqrt(f(r_emit) / f(r_obs))
the specific intensity scales as g^3
the bolometric flux scales as g^4 and equals 800 for g = 2
the observed wavelength equals the emitted wavelength divided by g
